records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated prayer-time icon for the mature Nur Islam app. Image 1 is our approved Dhuhr sun: PRIMARY STYLE reference. Match its simple rounded 3D shapes, matte satin materials, broad gentle shading, restrained warm gold tones and compact readable silhouette. Image 2 is our own prayer rug: supporting teal/ivory/gold palette and smooth material reference. A cohesive adult editorial app illustration, clearly readable at 32-44px, not photorealistic or childish. No face, no text, no Arabic, no watermark, no UI or card, no ornate rings or filigree, no chrome, no glossy gems, no sparkles or detached cast shadow, no glow halo. Center one compact symbol/group occupying about 78% of square canvas with truly TRANSPARENT background and clean alpha edges. FAJR / dawn before sunrise: a small softly rounded warm-ivory crescent above one simple low curved deep teal horizon/dune. A single small muted ivory four-point star beside the crescent. Crescent sits slightly upper-right relative to the dune, making a compact balanced grouped symbol. A very subtle cool muted blue dawn accent along the dune edge. NO sun disk, NO orange sunset, NO detailed scenery. Keep the crescent and one dune and tiny star simple, solid dimensional matte forms.
